crossRefs.note: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.

translations.web: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.
translations.bsb: He made a grate of bronze mesh for the altar under its ledge, halfway up from the bottom.
translations.kjv: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst
translations.asv: And he made for the altar a grating of network of brass, under the ledge round it beneath, reaching halfway up.
